{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    h = rng.randint(12, 25)
    w = rng.randint(10, 30)
    # choose 2-4 full horizontal marker lines, separated substantially
    n = rng.randint(2, min(4, max(2, h//4)))
    rows = sorted(rng.sample(range(2, h-2), n))
    # ensure separation
    while any(rows[i+1]-rows[i] < 3 for i in range(n-1)):
        rows = sorted(rng.sample(range(2, h-2), n))
    colors = rng.sample([1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9], n)
    g = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in zip(rows,colors): g[r] = [c]*w
    # place varied isolated/short objects in spaces, mostly matching and distractor colors
    for _ in range(rng.randint(n+1, n*4)):
        region = rng.randrange(n+1)
        lo = 0 if region==0 else rows[region-1]+1
        hi = h-1 if region==n else rows[region]-1
        if lo>hi: continue
        r=rng.randint(lo,hi); c=rng.randrange(w)
        col = rng.choice(colors+[rng.choice([7,8,9])])
        length = rng.choice([1,1,1,2])
        for x in range(c,min(w,c+length)):
            if g[r][x]==0: g[r][x]=col
    return g"}
